members.headline: Evaluating the impact of two decades of USAID interventions and projecting the effects of defunding on mortality up to 2030 (DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(25)01186-9)
members.note: Verbatim title from content/sources.json (en-lancet-usaid). 14.05M additional deaths by 2030 with an uncertainty interval of 8.48M to 19.66M, and about 91.8M deaths prevented 2001 to 2021. The figure always carries its June 2025 date. original.text: Ending USAID means 14 million more deaths by 2030
